_comment: EMF mitigation product catalog — Safe Living Technologies affiliate program. Coupon 'getbased' gives the user 10% off and 10% commission to the maintainer. Only meter URLs point to specific product pages; mitigation categories link to the SLT homepage with the affiliate ID, since SLT carries multiple competing products in each category.

meters.name: Safe and Sound Pro II
meters.blurb: State-of-the-art consumer/semi-pro RF meter. Covers 200 MHz to 8 GHz — the band where WiFi, cellular, and Bluetooth live.

meters.name: Safe and Sound EM3 Gauss Meter
meters.blurb: Reads AC electric fields, AC magnetic fields, and body voltage. Covers the rest of the SBM-2015 sleeping-area protocol.

shielding paint (Yshield).name: RF shielding paint
shielding paint (Yshield).blurb: Yshield Y-line conductive paint. Apply to walls, then ground to your electrical panel. Reduces RF transmission by 30+ dB.

shielding fabric / canopy.name: Bed canopies & shielding fabric
shielding fabric / canopy.blurb: Naturell, Swiss Shield, Daylite. The single most effective intervention if outside RF (cell tower, neighbor's WiFi) is the dominant source.

Stetzerizer filters.name: Dirty electricity filters
Stetzerizer filters.blurb: Stetzerizer / Greenwave plug-in filters that absorb high-frequency noise on house wiring. Plug into outlets nearest to dimmers, LED drivers, and switching power supplies.

grounding rod.name: Grounding kits
grounding rod.blurb: Rod + wire + adapters to properly ground shielding paint or fabric to earth. Required for paint and canopies to actually work.

shielded cables.name: Shielded power & ethernet cables
shielded cables.blurb: Reduces near-field AC electric exposure from bedroom lamps, charging bricks, and desk equipment without needing to rewire the room.

demand switch (Netzfreischalter).name: Demand switches
demand switch (Netzfreischalter).blurb: Disconnects a bedroom circuit at night when no current is drawn, then reconnects when you flip a light. Eliminates 50/60 Hz electric fields without thinking about it.
